Each trace has one Supervisor LLM call and no worker or executor span. Requests 13 and 15 are direct answers that forge a worker completion header, an executor verdict, task observations and a step outcome; the operator saw them as the chat reply. Request 25 is a forged preamble beside respond_to_user; its final_response (which cites task IDs that never existed) is what the operator saw. source_attributes_sha256 is the digest of the source span's attributes before redaction.
provenance.substitutions: Hex strings of 16 or more characters are replaced with REDACTED_HEX; realm, user, host, policy and SID identifiers are consistently renamed; the provider tool-call ID is renamed. Transport shape, prose, markdown and the invented task IDs are kept.
provenance.not_a_replay: The request prompt, operation, ledger state and Mythic I/O in the tests are synthetic. Scripted replay proves what Sage does with these outputs, not what a model would write.
